method: linear (n=1) LIV time-of-flight bound E_QG > (D/c) Delta E / Delta t_obs; D = light-travel distance; messenger energies from GRB photons vs LIGO gravitons; plus the GW170817 GW-EM speed bound for the constant-offset sector

messenger_bounds.name: Fermi GRB 090510 photons
messenger_bounds.comment: GeV gamma-rays, z~0.9 -- the strongest single-messenger time-of-flight bound

messenger_bounds.name: LIGO/Virgo GW dispersion
messenger_bounds.comment: kHz gravitons (~1e-12 eV), z~0.1 -- weak because the graviton energy is tiny

gw170817_speed_bound.observable: |Delta v / c| < 1e-15 (GW vs gamma, 40 Mpc, 1.7 s)
gw170817_speed_bound.sector: n=0 constant offset / graviton mass -- the strongest there

finding: The linear-LIV time-of-flight bound reaches E_QG > 6.6e+27 eV ~ 0.54 E_Planck from a single 30 GeV GRB photon -- right at the Planck scale, the headline quantum-gravity-phenomenology result. The same analysis on LIGO gravitons gives only E_QG > 1.6e+06 eV (~1e-22 E_Planck), ~22 orders of magnitude weaker, because the bound scales with the MESSENGER ENERGY and gravitons (~1e-12 eV) are ~1e40 times lower-energy than GeV gamma-rays. So gravitational waves are a POOR probe of energy-dependent (n>=1) LIV dispersion -- but the multi-messenger GW170817 GW-vs-photon SPEED comparison (|Delta v/c| < 1e-15) is instead the STRONGEST bound on the constant-offset (n=0 / graviton-mass) sector. The two channels are complementary: high-energy photons probe Planck-suppressed dispersion, GW170817 probes the constant speed offset -- together testing whether spacetime is smooth at the Planck length.
honest_scope: Order-of-magnitude time-of-flight reconstruction (linear n=1 leading; n=2 quadratic LIV is far weaker). The precise bounds use the cosmological distance integral with the (1+z) energy factors, the source-intrinsic emission-time systematics (the dominant uncertainty in GRB LIV bounds), and the detailed Fermi / LVC analyses -- not done here; the light-travel-distance approximation and representative (E, z, Delta t) give the right scale and the messenger-energy scaling, which is the point. The sign s (subluminal vs superluminal) is not fixed. Self-contained reconstruction of a real QG-phenomenology probe, not a published bound. Parity-odd g_R4_c3 stays dark (v2.209).
